answer: The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in quill, expire in dune, and sonnet lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 136 aliases therefore needs 20 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 611 identities would post 2963 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
